title:
Send something
to the right devices.
sub: The Actions page, rebuilt: pick who, pick what, send. Everything else got out of the way.

title: Venue, group, or the whole fleet
sub: Scope tabs keep the list short. One click adds every device at a venue.

title: Paste a list of serials
sub: Each one is checked against the fleet. Real devices get added, typos get called out.

title: The grid adapts
sub: Only actions every selected device can run. App picker closes after each pick.

title: Land on the result
sub: One send, one page. Every device acknowledges live.

title: What operators actually send
sub: Pinned setups, the most recent sends, and the ones repeated most. One click to resend.
